test_cases.title: A distribution search by a known reference lists that distribution
acs: DERIVED: Distributions Search accepts 15 real distribution references without an error (data/seed/distributions.json)
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin (Windows identity dt2\ns000134).
Data table: the Examples table of the matching scenario outline lists every row; each row is one execution.
Read-only: nothing is created, saved or deleted, so no data cleanup is needed.
Whether a row is listed depends on the format of the distribution number, so only the page and the absence of an error are checked.
Representative sample: one row stands for the 15 similar rows; the full list is kept in docs/full-examples/ and can be restored.

steps.action: Type the reference of the row in the Distribution Number box.

steps.expected: The page reloads with the h1 Search.

steps.action: Check the page for a server error message.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown.

open_questions: DERIVED criteria come from read-only probes of the running apps; confirm they are the intended behaviour.
